title: Epikloop compare list
description: ~/.epikloop/projects/<id>/compare/<code>.json: the pictures a retro's visual compare read, by fingerprint and size, which the next compare sorts today's pictures against. Written by `state.mjs --compare`, never by the model. The code is the first eight hex digits of the entries' own fingerprint, and a retro's record names it as `(snapshot <code>)`.

commit.description: The commit the checkout was at, abbreviated; null where git couldn't say.

pictures.description: One entry for each picture, in the order of their names. A pair that changed and wasn't read keeps the entry it had, so it stays listed until a retro reads it.

name.description: The picture's file name: <screen>.<state>.<width>.design.png, or .app.png. The state is one the manifest lists, or one the project's screens spec renders beyond it.

sha256.description: The fingerprint of the picture's bytes.
